title: People can SEE what you tell ChatGPT? #ai #chatgpt
description:
Are your ChatGPT privacy settings actually protecting your data? 

Many users assume their conversations are private, but your chats might be used for OpenAI data training or viewed by human reviewers. This breakdown clarifies how shared chats work and explains why deleted ChatGPT chats can still persist in system backups for up to 30 days.

Watch to learn how to lock down your account and keep your prompts secure.
